question: The Mughal emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar died in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1862.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar**

 
 
• Bahadur Shah Zafar **​**was the** twentieth and last Mughal Emperor** of India as well as an **Urdu poet.**
 
• He was the** second son** and the** successor to his father, Akbar II.**</l
